scope: CPU-only analysis of existing current-stage archives; no image review or training
content_score: sN - max(sB, sA); retain the existing biological-appearance protection group
validation_bio_dominant_proxy: sB >= max(sA, sN); not clean-photo ground truth
selection: Only the existing frozen margin >= 0.05 membership is a detector selection. Other thresholds/ranks describe the distribution; they create no new mask and have no content acceptance.
training_decision: Deliver the three offline diagnostics and stop. No automatic paired training, detector revision, relabeling or platform upload.
